Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Call summary:
- Primary use case: real-time customer support augmentation + post-conversation summarization for 10k monthly active agents.
- Estimated monthly token volumes (examples you gave): 250M - 1.2B tokens/month as usage scales; current pilot ~35M/month.
- Target business metrics you called out: target gross margin contribution per feature, CAC payback window ~9-12 months, and target top-level inference cost target of ~$15-$25 / 1M tokens for production.

Pricing/qualification asks (you asked us to confirm):
1) Representative $/1M tokens at different commitment tiers and expected on-platform unit economics for "Summarization" vs "Live Assist" (higher latencies and context sizes).
2) What the platform can deliver latency-wise for their baseline SLA (<=300ms p50 for short-turn responses).
3) A simple unit-econ worksheet mapping feature revenue -> tokens/feature -> $/feature and implications on gross margin at different price points.

Agreed next steps:
- I will send you a short unit-econ sketch + pricing tiers (attached) by EOD tomorrow. [Attachment: Redwood_pricing_v3.pdf]
- You will share the sample monthly token breakdown spreadsheet you mentioned. [Attachment: FintechX_unit_volumes.xlsx]
- Logan to review feasibility for caching/quantization options to hit the ~$15-$25 / 1M tokens target with acceptable quality.

If I missed anything, please flag. Otherwise, expect my follow-up with the high-level unit-econ table and a recommended commitment tier.

Best,
Marissa

marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 250M-1.2B range is our current forecast across three scenarios: pilot (35M), growth (250M), and scaled (1B+). The 35M is mainly for summarization and some routing. Live Assist (real-time suggestions) will push token sizes because of longer context windows.
- On pricing: our finance stakeholder gave a soft target of <= $20 / 1M tokens fully loaded (including network, inference, and caching inefficiencies) to keep feature-level margins above 30% at our current ARR targets.
- CAC/payback: our internal model requires a <=12 month CAC payback to greenlight an initial rollout.

I'll upload the token breakdown now — attaching the spreadsheet. Let me know if we should anonymize any fields first.
